title: Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformers for Hierarchical Intention Recognition from Multimodal Human Activity Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2610.18176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Proactive human-robot collaboration requires autonomous systems to infer not only immediate actions but also the underlying hierarchical intentions governing human behavior. Current deep learning approaches predominantly focus on flat action classification, failing to capture the structural dependencies connecting kinematic motion to high-level goals. A Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer (NSGT) is proposed within this multimodal framework, a Human Reasoning Graph (HR-G) is integrated into the self-attention mechanism via learnable topological biases. Furthermore, the architecture is augmented with a differentiable First-Order Logic (FOL) loss, acting as a structural regularizer by which ontological consistency is enforced across four levels: atomic actions, composite activities, Low-Level Intentions, and High-Level Intentions. Evaluation is performed on the synthesized NTU-Hierarchy dataset, a four-level ontological extension of NTU RGB+D

translated_title: 面向多模态人类活动序列分层意图识别的神经符号图Transformer
translated_abstract: 主动的人机协作要求自主系统不仅能推断即时动作，还要能推断支配人类行为的底层分层意图。当前的深度学习方法主要侧重于扁平的动作分类，无法捕捉连接运动学动作与高层目标之间的结构依赖关系。本文在多模态框架内提出了一种神经符号图Transformer（NSGT），通过可学习的拓扑偏置将人类推理图（HR-G）集成到自注意力机制中。此外，该架构还引入了可微分的一阶逻辑（FOL）损失，作为结构正则化器，在四个层次上强制执行本体一致性：原子动作、复合活动、低层意图和高层意图。评估在合成的NTU-Hierarchy数据集上进行，该数据集是NTU RGB+D的四层本体扩展。
tldr: 本文提出一种神经符号图Transformer（NSGT），通过将人类推理图嵌入自注意力机制并引入可微分一阶逻辑损失作为结构正则化器，实现了从多模态人类活动序列中对原子动作、复合活动、低层意图和高层意图四个层次的分层意图识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer (NSGT) that integrates a Human Reasoning Graph into the self-attention mechanism and employs a differentiable First-Order Logic loss as a structural regularizer to achieve hierarchical intention recognition across four levels—from atomic actions to high-level intentions—from multimodal human activity sequences.
